name: A Matter of Time
summary: Chromie asks you to use a Temporal Displacer near a silo in Andorhal. Temporal Parasites appear, and she needs the device returned at the Andorhal Inn.

sections.title: At Andorhal
sections.body: Chromie asks for your help in Andorhal, in the Western Plaguelands. A Temporal Displacer near one of the silos can uncover Temporal Parasites. You are asked to slay them and bring the device back to Chromie at the inn.

faq.q: What does Chromie ask me to do?
faq.answer: Chromie asks you to use a Temporal Displacer near one of Andorhal's silos to uncover Temporal Parasites, then return the device to her at the Andorhal Inn.
The Temporal Displacer is near one of the silos in Andorhal.

faq.q: Where do I return the device?
faq.answer: Return the Temporal Displacer to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, in the Western Plaguelands.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Matter of Time
